svg.title: IR sensor characterization: all 60 logged captures and repeated-capture spread
svg.desc: Raw ADC versus known target distance for left and right Sharp GP2Y0A21YK sensors. Three captures at each of ten distances. Means connect observed values without a fitted model. Both traces are nonmonotonic at long distances; repeat ranges increase.
svg.text: Sharp GP2Y0A21YK · raw serial captures · no fitted distance model
Review spread before choosing a distance model.
Circles: every logged capture (overlaps retained) Diamonds + lines: arithmetic means; connecting lines are visual guides.
Max − min of 3 captures · ADC counts
mV values are device-reported; no independent voltage measurement or distance-accuracy result is established.
Reproduce: python3 analysis/analyze_ir_calibration.py · Source records and ordered CSV are included.
